scope: Specification of positive inputs and expected behavior, and unsupported negative requests. This JSON defines cases and is not an execution log. Direct MCP calls and the SDK demo verify tool behavior; the demo does not test assistant routing. Actual native assistant test evidence is retained in the native release records.

positive.prompt: Busca en la primera página de BDNS hasta cuatro ayudas de digitalización. Incluye el número BDNS, las fechas publicadas y el enlace oficial.
positive.expected_behavior: Return at most four records from the first page with their BDNS numbers, published dates when available and official links. Identify any missing dates. If the source fails or only some sources respond, state the available coverage.

positive.prompt: Busca ayudas de digitalización en la página de índice 1 de BDNS, con un máximo de tres registros. Indica qué página revisaste.
positive.expected_behavior: Return at most three records and identify page index 1 as the second results page. Report the next page when the source provides one. If the source fails or only some sources respond, state the available coverage.

positive.prompt: Busca hasta tres ayudas de investigación en BDNS y muestra los tipos de beneficiario que consten en las fichas.
positive.expected_behavior: Cite the BDNS records and report published beneficiary types only when returned. Separate those categories from any individual eligibility determination. If the source fails or only some sources respond, state the available coverage.

positive.prompt: Busca hasta cinco ayudas de energía en BDNS y distingue posibles concesiones directas de convocatorias que requieren más revisión.
positive.expected_behavior: Label possible direct-award signals as preliminary. Separate them from records requiring review of dates and bases and link to the official records. If the source fails or only some sources respond, state the available coverage.

positive.prompt: Busca hasta dos ayudas de formación en BDNS y señala qué plazos constan y qué queda pendiente de comprobar en la sede.
positive.expected_behavior: For at most two records, give published dates and indicate which bases or application-portal checks remain. Published dates alone do not establish that applications can be submitted. If the source fails or only some sources respond, state the available coverage.

negative.prompt: Solicita esta subvención usando mi certificado.
negative.expected_behavior: Filing requires the official application process. Explain that the plugin only reads public grant records and does not submit or sign an application. Do not call compare_spanish_public_grants for this request.
An award depends on the granting authority. Explain that the plugin can report published criteria and dates but cannot guarantee an award. Do not call compare_spanish_public_grants for this request.

negative.prompt: Consulta mi expediente privado de subvenciones.
negative.expected_behavior: An individual case file is outside the public BDNS search. Explain that the user can open it in the competent authority’s official portal. Do not call compare_spanish_public_grants for this request.
